description: This source file defines a plugin class 'BitbucketDetector' for detecting Bitbucket Client ID and Client Secret tokens within text, by utilizing regex patterns. It extends a base class 'RegexBasedDetector' and provides specific regular expressions to identify secret patterns related to Bitbucket credentials.

classes.name: BitbucketDetector
classes.description: A detector class that scans for Bitbucket Client ID and Client Secret keywords and patterns within text to identify potential secrets.

methods.name: str secret_type(self)
methods.description: Returns the type of secret this detector is designed to find, which is 'Bitbucket Secrets'.

methods.name: list[re.Pattern] denylist(self)
methods.description: Provides a list of compiled regex patterns used to match and detect potential Bitbucket secrets such as Client ID and Client Secret.
